description: This file defines the Error controller class for the Opencart Catalog Startup namespace. It manages error handling, logging, and error page redirection within the OpenCart e-commerce system.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Handles PHP errors and exceptions, logs errors, and redirects upon critical errors within the OpenCart startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes error handling by setting custom error and exception handlers, and setting up logging based on configuration.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles PHP errors, logs them, displays or redirects based on configuration, and categorizes errors into notices, warnings, and fatal errors.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions, logs them, displays the error message, or redirects to an error page depending on configuration.
